purpose: Replace one huge scene_contract with preflight -> context_request -> context_slice. Full cards remain in repo; Railway returns only scene-needed blocks.

pipeline.name: preflight
pipeline.description: Return active state, current calendar beat, last scene summary, immediate constraints. No full cards.

pipeline.name: gpt_scene_planning
pipeline.description: GPT determines scene type, location focus, block needs, and sends context_request.

pipeline.name: railway_validation
pipeline.description: Railway checks calendar, schedule, location, availability, permission, and hidden/past triggers.

pipeline.name: context_slice
pipeline.description: Railway returns only approved small slices: state, location, schedule, character blocks, relationship blocks.

pipeline.name: scene_render
pipeline.description: GPT writes scene from context_slice only.

pipeline.name: apply_turn_result
pipeline.description: GPT sends proposed_updates; API validates and persists state.

hard_rules: Do not return full YAML cards to Custom GPT Actions by default.
Do not split a huge card into chunks; request semantic blocks instead.
State active slice is always needed, but full state history is not.
Location basic slice is needed for every scene.
Schedule slice is needed for base/public/location movement scenes; schedule files may be empty placeholders until filled.
Character full cards remain authoritative in repo; context slices are derived from full cards, not from separate runtime summaries.
Railway may deny a requested block if calendar, location, knowledge, energy, or past triggers do not allow it.
